top_fixes.rule: If `verify_identity` returns `hint: "day_month_swapped"`, ask the customer to repeat the date with the month said as a word. One such retry per call does not count as a wrong answer; any further swapped answer counts.
top_fixes.why: If the service already counts the swapped-date answer as wrong, the ask_dob fallback route (wrong_answers_left == "1") sends the call to fin_exhausted after only one real wrong answer, so the close_call outcome/reason is wrong in every free-retry case.
top_fixes.fix: ask_dob transition 3 (-> fin_exhausted, condition verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left equals "1"): either delete it and rely on the post_process_code counter that already skips the first day_month_swapped hint, or add a second condition so it only fires when hint_day_month_swapped is not set. Also make sure verify_identity post_process_code counts a second or later swapped hint as a wrong answer (increment the wrong counter when hint_day_month_swapped >= 2), so the rule's three-wrong-answers limit still applies.

top_fixes.rule: If the customer says the full amount is too much, propose the floor once and say the remainder stays overdue and the account stays in arrears until cleared. Declining the floor is a flat refusal (rule 31). The floor may be named a second time only as attempt 2 (rule 31).
top_fixes.why: When the customer said the full amount is too much, item 5 has attempt 1 name the floor again. That names the floor a second time outside attempt 2, which the brief forbids, and it changes the amount on offer and the order of the negotiation that the test cases check.
top_fixes.fix: negotiate.task_message item 5: replace the attempt-1 line with "- Attempt 1: propose paying the full amount {{past_due_fmt}} on {{attempt1_text}}. Do not name the floor here if you already offered it under item 4." In item 4 add: "Offer the floor {{floor_fmt}} once only and say the remainder stays overdue and the account stays in arrears until cleared. If the customer turns down the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 31)." In the attempt-2 line say the floor may be named again only there.

top_fixes.rule: The call is to customers whose payment on a single product is between 1 and 45 days overdue: reach the right person, run the security check, explain the overdue amount, agree a payment where possible, and end with the outcome and reason from section 12. Nothing in the brief may be replaced by the assistant's own judgement.
top_fixes.why: Accounts outside 1–45 days overdue (0 days, or more than 45) still go to negotiate. Every days_late > 10 becomes amber with no upper limit, so the agent negotiates in cases where the brief does not allow this call.
top_fixes.fix: prepare code: after days_late is computed, set vars['in_scope'] = 'true' if 1 <= days_late <= 45 else 'false'. Add a first transition from prepare: if in_scope equals "false" -> a fin_out_of_scope code node that sets the section-12 outcome/reason for an account outside the call's scope (or the brief's closest 'not eligible' pair), then -> its end terminal. Keep the amber band to 11 <= days_late <= 45.
